items.content_html: Incident Priority Recommendation is a lightweight web app built with React, Node.js, and MySQL. It lets users to submit the urgency & impact of an incident and automatically recommends a priority level. Docker, GitLab CI, and GitHub Actions are used for building, storing, and deploying the app on AWS EC2 with CloudWatch alarms.
